quarterly_data.signal: ASML's H1 2026 statutory interim report (6-K): total net sales by customer location in H1 2026 versus H1 2025 were South Korea EUR 7,085.5 million (EUR 4,413.6 million), Taiwan EUR 5,114.7 million (EUR 4,361.9 million), China EUR 2,883.3 million (EUR 3,712.3 million), United States EUR 1,939.6 million (EUR 1,942.8 million), Japan EUR 440.3 million (EUR 492.9 million), EMEA EUR 407.1 million (EUR 314.2 million) and Singapore EUR 221.8 million (EUR 194.3 million), out of EUR 18,093.4 million.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026: South Korea EUR 7,085.5 million; Taiwan EUR 5,114.7 million; China EUR 2,883.3 million (from EUR 3,712.3 million)

quarterly_data.signal: ASML's H1 2026 statutory interim report (6-K): R&D costs were EUR 2.5 billion in H1 2026 (EUR 1.8 billion in H1 2025), mainly EXE-related activities to support future nodes for Logic and DRAM customers; NXE-related activities for the NXE:3800F and NXE:4200G platforms; DUV work on throughput and overlay and next-generation 3D integration solutions, including the XT:260 platform, to support advanced packaging; and e-beam inspection, e-beam metrology and YieldStar optical metrology including the next-generation YS 550, plus the multibeam inspection roadmap with development of the eScan 2200.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 R&D EUR 2.5 billion; programs include NXE:3800F, NXE:4200G, XT:260, YS 550, eScan 2200
